name: dsh-prompt-limiter
description: 提示词控制器：查看各方（每个 Agent / 子智能体）系统提示词的大小——按静态段落、运行时上下文、工具 schema 分类的字符数与 ≈token 估算，并可为单段或整体设置自定义上限（只观测 / 截断 / 丢弃）。零依赖、无构建步骤。Prompt size controller for DeepSeek Harness: inspect every party's assembled system prompt (static sections, runtime contexts, tool schemas) in characters and estimated tokens, and set custom per-section or total limits with warn / truncate / drop actions. Zero dependencies, no build step.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/integration.mjs && node test/render.mjs
